block_updates.text: Important mathematical words used throughout the week.

Working materials: exercise books, pencils, rulers, squared paper and teacher-drawn figures. Attempt the questions independently after discussing one example with a partner. Measure lines carefully, show mathematical working, and compare methods respectfully.

parts.text: Lesson 1: A = 36 cm², P = 26 cm; B = 360 m², P = 78 m; C = length 12 cm, area 96 cm²; D = x = 6, common side 19 cm.
Lesson 2: A = 12 cm; B = 10 m; C = 13 cm; D = 2 cm on each of the four sides.
Lesson 3: A = 200 cm²; B = 128 cm²; C = 48 cm²; D = use subtraction for a whole figure with holes, or addition for separated non-overlapping shaded pieces.
Lesson 4: A = 8 cm; B = 15 m; C = 12 cm; D = the perpendicular is at 90 degrees to the base.
Lesson 5: A = 8 cm; B = 12 m; C = 12 cm; D = answers vary; compare base × height products.
Lesson 6: A = 98 cm²; B = 240 m²; C = 5,000 cm²; D = 55 cm²; E = two congruent trapezia form a parallelogram with double the original trapezium area.
